title: When a notification with a context menu moves down, the context menu doesn't move.
line: A file menu opened from a screenshot notification now stays fully on screen when the notification slides down.
explanation: The thumbnail's file menu is an xdg popup attached to the notification window. When the notifications below expired and the window slid down, KWin moved the menu along with it but never ran its constraint adjustment again (Qt doesn't make the positioner reactive), so the menu ran past the bottom edge and under the panel. The menu now follows its notification window with a move, which makes Qt send xdg_popup.reposition so KWin places it again (flipping it above the button or click point); the right-click path also gets an explicit anchor at the click point so repositioning stays relative to it.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: Keep the file menu on screen when the notification moves

The file menu moved along with its notification but was never placed
again, so it ran off the bottom of the screen when the notification slid
down. Now it is moved with it, so the compositor constrains it again.

BUG: 486595
